standard-dialogue-outside-ver-sinhaza.text: If the player isn't wearing a Vyre disguise:

steps.npc: What's your problem, food sack? Better move on before I perforate you real good!

standard-dialogue-outside-ver-sinhaza.text: If the player is wearing a Vyre disguise:

standard-dialogue-in-darkmeyer.text: If the player isn't wearing a Vyre disguise:

steps.npc: You're not meant to be here human! Time to die!

standard-dialogue-in-darkmeyer.text: If the player is wearing a Vyre disguise:

steps.npc: Minding my own business. You should do the same.
Then why don't you get lost?
I'm not interested in making small talk.

after-applying-guthix-balance.text: If the Vampyre Juvenile is instantly killed:

steps.text: The Vampyre Juvenile dies and leaves Vampyre dust behind.

after-applying-guthix-balance.text: If the Vampyre Juvenile is turned into a Feral Vampyre:

steps.text: The Vampyre Juvenile transforms into a Feral Vampyre.

after-applying-guthix-balance.text: If the Vampyre Juvenile is successfully cured:

steps.text: The Vampyre Juvenile turns into human form, becoming Benjamin, Liam, Miala, Verak, or a Former Vampyre.

steps.speaker: Human
steps.text: Thanks so much for saving me from being a vampyre. Here, take this certificate, I'm sorry but it's all I can offer as a reward.

when-reduced-below-25-hitpoints.npc: Ha, ha, ha, time to disappear and rejuvenate!
